title: Unified gateway trace panel semantics
description: Implementation-backed dashboard suggestions for Elastic APM 8.15. This is a semantic specification, not a saved object import. The companion generator supplies the ug.* runtime fields.

primaryReferences.purpose: OTLP root, Server and Consumer spans become transactions; other children become spans. Outcome and semantic attribute mappings are defined here.
Resource fields, underscore-normalized labels, numeric_labels, and boolean labels encoded as strings.
Packaged ingest converts event.duration nanoseconds into span.duration.us or transaction.duration.us and removes event.duration.
Native deliver Consumer and publish Producer operation names when UseRoutingKeyAsOperationName is false.
Runtime scripts can read params._source as a Map/List tree; keyword uses emit(String), double uses emit(double), and null must not be emitted.
Source-based runtime fields avoid requiring doc values, at higher query cost than indexed or doc-value fields.
Trace link route and optional rangeFrom/rangeTo query parameters.
Trace links locate the root transaction, falling back to the trace waterfall; omitted range covers epoch through now.

importantConstraints: Counts are sampled recorded delivery or dispatch attempts, not exact business totals or unique messages. Retries add attempts.
Filter source traffic to rabbitmq handler. Counting all transactions also includes native deliver, root Elasticsearch work, and possibly HTTP requests.
Native deliver can show success when a child handler returns a handled retry or rejection; use rabbitmq handler outcome for processing KPIs.
Handler failures include retry, rejected input, and cancellation. Do not label these permanent message loss.
Handler duration includes outcome completion (ACK/retry/DLQ), but excludes time waiting in the broker queue.
A successful dispatch means transport accepted the request/message; it does not measure downstream algorithm completion.
Durations are inclusive. Summing handler, dispatch and child transport durations double-counts elapsed work.
There is no unified_gateway.process or unified_gateway.consume span. PipelineStageScope emits metrics only.
Rule loading has no dedicated gateway span. Elasticsearch operations are traced but do not include the full rule validation/cache-refresh duration.
Custom attributes do not automatically inherit to child spans. Pipeline ID exists on preparation and dispatch, while handler can fan out to multiple pipelines.
A global pipeline filter hides source handler traces, native transport spans and rule-search spans. Use pipeline filtering only on the relevant panels.

Image, area and sensor tags are added to the handler only after parsing succeeds; filtered and invalid input traces can lack them. A global image filter hides preparation/dispatch traces that do not inherit those tags. Locate the source image first, then filter by trace.id to inspect the entire trace.
The supplied deployment uses service.environment Integration while log namespace is integration. Normalize environment values to lowercase for cross-signal filtering.

The trace data view defaults to traces-apm*,apm-* for current streams and legacy APM indices. Restrict every trace panel to processor.event span/transaction so legacy aggregated metric/error documents cannot inflate counts.
The confirmed deployed service.name is Unified Gateway. Regenerate with the actual deployed service.name if OTEL_SERVICE_NAME changes it.
Source-based runtime fields require _source and can cost more than indexed fields. Keep useful time windows and normalize physical fields at ingest for very large deployments.

ug.operation.description: Use span.name for processor.event=span and transaction.name for processor.event=transaction. Do not use the parent transaction name as the operation of a child span.

ug.duration_ms.description: For the document's event type, read span.duration.us or transaction.duration.us and divide by 1000. Fall back to event.duration divided by 1000000 only if no legacy duration exists.

ug.environment.description: Lowercase log data_stream.namespace or trace service.environment. Prefer service.environment for traces; trace stream namespace can be default even when application environment is Integration.

runtimeFieldSemantics.sourceTraversal: Read params._source with null/type guards. Support both literal dotted keys and nested Map objects. Do not emit null, objects, or arrays into scalar keyword/double fields.

fieldMappings.scope: handler and dispatch; IDs have different meaning

operations.name: publish
operations.unit: native broker publish; includes retry/DLQ traffic

traceLink.spaceAndBasePath: Prefix Kibana's configured base path and /s/<space-id> for a non-default Space. The path has no hash fragment.
traceLink.withoutRange: Kibana 8.15 searches epoch through current time, avoiding a misleading no-trace result when opening an older dashboard event.
traceLink.requirements: APM access and APM trace index configuration covering the indexed trace. A manual or unsampled trace ID in a log is not proof the trace was retained.

panels.title: Source attempt failure percentage
panels.description: Includes retry, rejection and cancellation. Sampled attempts, not permanent message loss.

panels.description: Transport failures before a response have no HTTP status and are shown separately in failure categories.

panels.title: Elasticsearch rule-search p95 latency
panels.description: Measures Elasticsearch requests, not full rule refresh/validation duration.

panels.title: Operation volume and latency
panels.description: Compare operation timings; do not add inclusive parent and child durations.
